achievements.name: Cincinnatus
achievements.description: Appoint a Dictator, and have the same Dictator voluntarily stand down.

achievements.name: Tribal Concord
achievements.description: Whilst you have a tribal government form, change a Law.

achievements.name: Render Unto Caesar
achievements.description: Conquer a city.

achievements.name: A New Home
achievements.description: Settle a new territory as a Migratory Tribe.

achievements.name: Alea Iacta Est
achievements.description: Have an appointed Dictator refuse to give up power.

achievements.name: Soldier of Fortune
achievements.description: Send a disloyal pretender away to be a Mercenary.

achievements.name: Panem Et Circenses
achievements.description: Compete in the Olympic Games on at least 10 occasions.

achievements.name: International Relations
achievements.description: With your current ruler, acquire two other ruler-level friends.

achievements.name: Strategic Reserve
achievements.description: Import at least one of each Strategic resource to your capital province.

achievements.name: Triumvir
achievements.description: Survive a Civil War.

achievements.name: Legacy of Aristotle
achievements.description: Have four Researchers with at least 11 finesse each.

achievements.name: Do Not Disturb My Circles
achievements.description: Research 40 inventions.

achievements.name: Tribal Assembly
achievements.description: As a Tribe, enact the decision to become a Republic.

achievements.name: Hispania Universalis
achievements.description: Form Greater Iberia

achievements.name: What have the Romans ever done for us?
achievements.description: As Rome, own at least one City with 70 or more Civilization Value in each Province within the Palestine region.

achievements.name: Punic Ascendance
achievements.description: As Carthage, own or have a subject own all of Hispania.

achievements.name: Times New Roman
achievements.description: As Rome, conquer the cities of Cariala, Italica, and Aquae Helveticae.

achievements.name: Antipater's Dream
achievements.description: As Macedonia, own the region of Greece.

achievements.name: The Besieger
achievements.description: As the Antigonids, sack the territories of Babylon, Alexandria, Lysimacheia, and Pella.

achievements.name: Over 9000!
achievements.description: Have at least 9000 pops.

achievements.name: The Romans are Crazy
achievements.description: Form Gaul.

achievements.name: Carthago Delenda Est
achievements.description: As Rome, own and sack the city of Carthage.

achievements.name: New Kingdom
achievements.description: Form Egypt, enact the Egyptian Succession law, and conquer the regions of Nubia and Syria.

achievements.name: Pyrrhic Victory
achievements.description: As Epirus, own Rome.

achievements.name: Perfidious Albion
achievements.description: Form Albion before the year AUC 500.

achievements.name: Imperial Ambition
achievements.description: Adopt the Empire government form.

achievements.name: Envy of the World
achievements.description: Have any owned city with 100 or more Civilization Value.

achievements.name: Pan-Hellenic League
achievements.description: As any Greek Republic, own the entire region of Greece.

achievements.name: Mystery Solved
achievements.description: As a Megalithic country, own at least 20 cities producing Stone, and the city of Cunetio.

achievements.name: Soter
achievements.description: As Egypt, own all of the historical wonders of the world, through conquest or construction.

achievements.name: To the End of the World
achievements.description: As the Seleucid Empire or Bactria, conquer the regions of Gandhara, Mahdyadesa, Pracya, Maru, and Avanti.

achievements.name: Three Great Fires
achievements.description: Form Persia, and own Ganzak, Nevshapur, and Gur.

achievements.name: Holy Fire
achievements.description: Desecrate Holy Sites for at least 10 different religions.

achievements.name: No More Worlds Left to Conquer
achievements.description: Reform Alexander's Empire as a successor state.

achievements.name: Garum Nobile
achievements.description: In any owned city, produce a surplus of at least 10 fish.

achievements.name: True Vandal
achievements.description: As a Vandal nation, own any territory in the regions of Mauretania, Numidia, Africa, or Cyrenaica, and occupy Rome in a war.

achievements.name: Germania Magna
achievements.description: As a Germanic nation, own every city in the regions of Germania, Germania Superior, Vistulia, and Boiohaemum.

achievements.name: The Man who would be King
achievements.description: As Bactria, become independent, and conquer the regions of Ariana, Bactria, and Gandhara.

achievements.name: Ashoka's Pillars
achievements.description: As the Mauryas, conquer all of India, convert to Buddhism, and have at least 80% Religious Unity.

achievements.name: Mare Nostrum
achievements.description: As Rome, own every city adjacent to the Mediterranean Sea.

achievements.name: Megalopolis
achievements.description: As the nation of Megalopolis, have at least 80 pops in the city of Megalopolis.

achievements.name: The Bois Are Back in Town
achievements.description: As Boi, conquer or colonize the entire region of Boiohaemum.

achievements.name: Molon Labe!
achievements.description: As Sparta, conquer and sack the city of Persepolis.

achievements.name: The Spice Must Flow
achievements.description: As Mosylon, own every Spice producing city in the world.

achievements.name: Kingdom of David
achievements.description: Starting as a Jewish nation, own the regions of Palestine and Syria, as well as the areas of Sinai, Eastern Delta, Central Delta, Memphis, Euphrates, Niniveh, Mespotamia Superior, Tigris, Babylonia, Asoristan, and Veh Kavad.

achievements.name: rednaxelA
achievements.description: Starting as a Hindu, Buddhist, or Jain nation, which is not the Mauryas, conquer Pataliputra, Babylon, Memphis, and Athens.

achievements.name: Heraclea Persica
achievements.description: Starting as Heraclea Pontica, form Persia whilist your ruler belongs to the Achaemenid dynasty.

achievements.name: Tyrian Purple
achievements.description: Form Phoenicia, own at least 500 ships, and produce a surplus of at least 5 dyes in Tyrus.

achievements.name: Pax Aeterna
achievements.description: Conquer the world.

achievements.name: City of the World's Desire
achievements.description: Have 15 Trade Routes in Byzantium.

achievements.name: Pentecontaetia
achievements.description: As Athens, be independent and own Delos, Naxos, Kassandreia, Thaso, Chalkis, Samos, Sestos, Kition, Salamis, and Oreos before 500 AUC.

achievements.name: Laconic If
achievements.description: As Sparta, conquer and sack Pella before 480 AUC.

achievements.name: Potter to King
achievements.description: As Syracuse, conquer all of Sicily by the death of your ruler, Agathocles.

achievements.name: Pytheas' Legacy
achievements.description: As Massalia, own at least one territory in Dumnonia and Cantiacia, as well as one territory in the Scandia region, and the territory of Orcades, before 550.

achievements.name: Brennus' Revenge
achievements.description: As a Gallic Tribe, desecrate all Hellenic Holy Sites in Greece before 480 AUC.

achievements.name: Holy Pilgrim
achievements.description: As a Jewish country, own and control all original Jewish Holy Sites: Ekbatana, Oros Chorib, Apologos, Jerusalem, Ephraim, Sousa, Kadasa and Aqola.

achievements.name: Catch them All
achievements.description: As a Polytheistic country, have a State Pantheon composed entirely of deified rulers.

achievements.name: An Unexpected Turn
achievements.description: As Grania, Raumaricia, Suionia, Leuonia, Guthonia, Dania or Burgundia, build an Ivory Tower in Uppakra with all effects upgraded to Tier 4.

achievements.name: Wonder Builder
achievements.description: Build a Great Wonder.

achievements.name: The Great Destroyer
achievements.description: Playing as any nation from the Veneti, Germanic, Pretani, Gaelic, Gallic, Celt-Iberian, Iberian or Pre-Indo-European culture groups, conquer and destroy 10 Great Wonders.

achievements.name: On the Measure of the Earth
achievements.description: As any Greek nation, build Towers in Omboi and Alexandria.

achievements.name: The Corners of the World
achievements.description: As any nation, build Great Wonders in Safim, Orcades, Sadiya, Odoka and Agawe.

achievements.name: Land of the Rising Sun
achievements.description: As a country in the Anatolian Culture Group, own, or have a subject own, the regions of Asia, Phrygia, Cilicia, Bithynia et Paphlagonia, Cappadocia Taurica and Armenia.

achievements.name: Gazophylax This!
achievements.description: As Thrace, kill the ruler of the Antigonid Kingdom, by completing the “Poetic Justice” mission task.

achievements.name: King of the Blind
achievements.description: As the Antigonid Kingdom, enact the decision “Secure Antigonid Position”.

achievements.name: Periplus of the Seas
achievements.description: As Egypt, own or have a subject own the Aegean Islands, Rhodes, Sicily, Sardinia, Cyprus, Alalaiou (Dahkla), Devada, Diouscourides (Socotra), Tylos (Bahrain), Sri Lanka, Mliet/Malta, Yermena, Corsica, Gymnaesia (Baleares), Korkyra and Qarkna.

achievements.name: Legio Augusta
achievements.description: Own a Legion with X honors.

achievements.name: Nikator
achievements.description: As the Seleucid Empire, conquer Pella before the death of Seleucus Nikator.

achievements.name: Hall of the Mountain King
achievements.description: As Armenia, construct a level XV Fortress.

achievements.name: Ktistes
achievements.description: Starting as Kios, form Pontus.

achievements.name: Proclamation of Tyre
achievements.description: As a Greek Republic, have Macedon, Egypt, the Seleucid Empire, Thrace or the Antigonid Empire as a subject.

achievements.name: Eumenes' Footsteps
achievements.description: As Cappadocia, keeping Macedonian primary culture, become independent and conquer Alexandria and Babylon.
